verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms an online filing system exists, but nothing in the pack describes its sign-in or authentication method. There is no mention of credential MFA, and none of biometric liveness, in-person verification or mailed PINs. The probe of the filing host failed at connection, so no sign-in flow was observed, and identity walls are a fair axis for a state filing portal, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
